title: A backend developer built his own Bloomberg terminal on Grok for 300 dollars a month.
description:
A backend developer built his own Bloomberg terminal on Grok for 300 dollars a month. The real one costs around 28 thousand dollars a year. Then he open-sourced the entire blueprint.

His name is Roan, RohOnChain on X, and his setup runs about 300 sub-agents, each with a permanent job: 20 watch macro, 60 track earnings, 80 read news wires, 40 watch video, 60 follow insider filings. They share one cloud machine and pass files to each other like a real research desk, 24/7. Every morning he wakes up to a briefing with market sentiment pulled from X and news, plus his portfolio tracked overnight. The whole thing rides SuperGrok Heavy at 300 dollars a month, roughly 8 to 9 times cheaper than a Bloomberg seat. His setup, his numbers.

The honest limits, from Roan himself: this does not replace Bloomberg's licensed real-time data feeds, and it's a research desk, not a trading terminal. Nobody is promising you returns.

Comment TERMINAL and I'll send you the link to the full blueprint. Follow for more AI that actually matters.
